entities.summary: Jean-Claude Biver is a Luxembourg-born Swiss watchmaking executive. He previously served as the chief executive officer (CEO) of TAG Heuer. From 2014 until 2018, he was the president of LVMH's watchmaking division until his retirement after 43 years in the industry.
